causes.label: The mains plug of the power cord is not plugged in.
remedies: Connect the appliance to the power supply.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 14: "The mains plug of the power cord is not plugged in."

causes.label: The circuit breaker in the fuse box has tripped.
remedies: Check the circuit breaker in the fuse box.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 14: "The circuit breaker in the fuse box has tripped."

causes.label: There has been a power cut.
remedies: Check whether the lighting in your room or other appliances are working.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 14: "There has been a power cut."

causes.label: Malfunction
remedies: Switch off the fuse in the fuse box.
Switch the fuse on after appox. 10 seconds.
If the malfunction occurs again, call customer service.

causes.label: Door is not fully closed.
remedies: Check whether food remains or foreign material are trapped in the door.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 14: "Door is not fully closed."

symptoms.symptom: Food takes longer than usual to heat up.

causes.label: The microwave power setting is set too low.
remedies: Set a higher microwave power setting.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 14: "The microwave power setting is set too low."

causes.label: A larger amount than usual has been placed in the appliance.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 14: "A larger amount than usual has been placed in the appliance."

causes.label: You need double the time when you have double the amount. The food is colder than usual.
remedies: Turn or stir the food from time to time during cooking.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 14: "You need double the time when you have double the amount. The food is colder than usual."

causes.label: There is dirt or foreign objects in the area of the turntable drive.
remedies: Clean the roller ring and recess in the cooking compartment.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 14: "There is dirt or foreign objects in the area of the turntable drive."

causes.label: Appliance has a fault.
remedies: If this fault recurs, call the after-sales service.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 14: "Appliance has a fault."
